title: East Nashville Retreat Selfie Wall Rooftop Deck
description:
Stay in this stylish East Nashville condo just minutes from downtown, Broadway, and top attractions. Walk to restaurants, bars, and live music or explore nearby hotspots like the Johnny Cash Museum and Music Row. Enjoy a modern kitchen, selfie wall, rooftop deck, fast WiFi, and in-unit washer/dryer. Relax in comfort after a day in Music City with plush bedrooms and smart TVs.

The space
Enjoy East Nashville from this stylish second-floor condo near restaurants, local bars, boutique shopping, live music, and downtown attractions. Broadway is about 2.7 miles away, Nissan Stadium is about 1.7 miles away, and the Ryman Auditorium and Johnny Cash Museum are about 1.9 miles away.

The condo sleeps up to four guests・2 Bedroom, Sleeps 4
・Bedroom 1: one king bed
・Bedroom 2: one queen bed

Inside, you’ll find a modern full kitchen, bistro dining tables, a playful selfie wall with saddle seating, three smart TVs, Bluetooth sound, central air conditioning, fast WiFi, and an in-unit washer and dryer. Head to the shared rooftop deck to relax and enjoy the city atmosphere. The building has elevator access, and garage and nearby street parking are available.

Streaming services are available with guests’ own accounts.

Guest access
As our guest, you'll have full access to the entire property, except for a few areas reserved for house supplies.

Other things to note
Check-in is at 4:00 PM and checkout is at 10:00 AM. Quiet hours are 10:00 PM–8:00 AM. Smoking is not permitted. Streaming services are available with guests’ own accounts.
